_about: Mods known to break R.E.P.O or to clash with LateJoinPlus. The reports workflow checks every report against this list: a mod in the player's list at a version <= brokenUpTo (or any version when omitted) with one of the evidence patterns in the log is answered, labelled mod:<guid> and closed, and the Discord channel list is updated. kind: broken | replaced | duplicate. evidence: regular expressions (case-insensitive) tested on the stored report text; leave empty to match on the installed version alone.

harmless.pattern: PlayerCosmetics: No colors equipped after \d+ seconds, equipping default colors\.
harmless.why: The game equipped default cosmetic colors.

harmless.pattern: Failed to find a PhotonView with ID=\d+ for incoming OwnershipUpdate event
harmless.why: A network ownership update arrived after its object was removed.

harmless.pattern: Received RPC "[^"]+" for viewID \d+ but this PhotonView does not exist
harmless.why: A network message arrived after its object was removed.

harmless.pattern: RPC method '[^']+' not found on object with PhotonView \d+
harmless.why: Another player's mod sent a network message this game does not handle.
The game's voice recorder stopped recording.
The game logged a network disconnect report.

harmless.pattern: Screen position out of view frustum
harmless.why: The game tried to display a position outside the camera view.
A game prop has no valuable volume.

harmless.pattern: Can't remove PhotonView \(Script\) because EnemyParent \(Script\) depends on it
harmless.why: The game kept a network component needed by an enemy.
There was no save folder to delete.

mods.name: ShrinkerCartPlus
mods.problem: throws an error every frame on every cart, so the host lags.

mods.name: Empress Spawn Browser
mods.problem: calls a player speed method the game no longer has and stalls loading.

mods.name: RepoLateJoin
mods.problem: cannot load on this game version, and LateJoinPlus already does late join.

mods.name: MorePlayers
mods.problem: has a dead patch on this game version; LateJoinPlus already raises the player limit.

mods.name: Unlimited Range + Scroll
mods.problem: its patch breaks the game's grab raycast.

mods.name: Pet Companion
mods.problem: its follower script throws an error every frame.

mods.name: AlwaysWingsView
mods.problem: is built for an older game and errors thousands of times on Tumble Wings.

mods.name: KeybindLib
mods.problem: breaks the game's input setup (players can turn invisible or controls fail).
mods.fix: Update it, or remove it and the mods that need it.

mods.name: MoreUpgrades
mods.problem: its upgrade stand patch fails on this game version.

mods.name: ExtractionPointConfirmButton
evidence: ExtractionPointPatch: Failed to spawn confirm button
mods.problem: cannot spawn its confirm button on this game version.

mods.name: DUSHIKAPSA
evidence: Parameter "name" not found in method void PunManager::SetItemNameLOGIC
mods.problem: patches the game's item-naming method with an old parameter name, which breaks every other mod's patch on it.

mods.name: Empress Ban Enforcer
mods.problem: reads a SteamManager field the game no longer has and errors on every refresh.

mods.name: PublicGameSaves
mods.problem: patches a lobby-creation page that no longer exists, so its patches fail to load.

mods.name: Empress Blackbox Fixer
mods.problem: patches ShopInitialize by name, which has two overloads now, so its patch fails.

mods.name: StartWithGun + StartWithGunFixed
mods.problem: the same mod is installed twice.
